name: vibe-enterprise-framework-plugins
description: Official plugin collection for Vibe Enterprise Framework
author: Vibe Enterprise Framework Team

plugins.name: Quick Actions
plugins.description: Quick access to framework CLI commands: warm cache, show stats, scan, index, clear cache, and code graph.

plugins.name: Status Line
plugins.description: Real-time status bar monitor displaying cache warmth, active skills, rules count, and token usage.

plugins.name: Automation & Hooks
plugins.description: Automated background indexing on file save, git hooks installer, TDD quality gate validator, and sync triggers.

plugins.name: Context Monitor
plugins.description: Token budget analyzer, session memory inspector, and context routing visualization.

plugins.name: Spec Kit (SDD)
plugins.description: Spec-Driven Development assistant for authoring specs, blueprints, atomic tasks, and running TDD checks.

plugins.name: Security & Pentest Suite
plugins.description: 183+ pentesting and OSINT tools integration for automated security recon and vulnerability audit.
